newsitem.title: USA: Costilla acquires oil reserves for $42 million.
newsitem.headline: Costilla acquires oil reserves for $42 million.

text.p: Costilla Energy Inc. said Thursday it will acquire proven reserves of 6 million barrels of oil equivalent and 160,000 undeveloped acres from Billings, Mont.-based Ballard Petroleum LLC for $42 million.
The proven reserves and undeveloped acreage are in the Rocky Mountain region.
Costilla said it expects to budget $15 million for capital projects related to the acquired properties in the first 12 months after the deal closes, funded mostly through cash flow.
The deal would increase the percentage of Costilla's asset value that is in the Rocky Mountain region to 35 percent, from 25 percent.
Costilla currently produces 13,500 barrels of oil equivalent per day, about 50 percent of which is liquids and 50 percent natural gas.
Costilla's stock rose 56 cents to $13.125 on Nasdaq shortly before midday.
